assessmentSummary.identity: One Leg Swings Lateral repetition is a supported stationary stance on one foot, a controlled pendular swing of the free leg across the body then away to the side through a comfortable frontal-plane range, and return to the start; complete declared repetitions then switch sides. It is not a front/back swing, walking swing, kick, march, lunge, hop, balance test, or run.

currentCardSnapshot.description: Facing or beside a stable wall or rail on a clear level surface, establish a light support contact and rooted stance foot. Swing the free leg across the body then away to the side like a controlled pendulum only through the available comfortable frontal-plane hip range, return to the start, complete the declared repetitions, then switch sides. This excludes front/back direction, walking, kicking, marching, lunging, hopping, assessment, and running.
